screenshots.alt: You choose the text, and where it is read. Selected text, the visible article or a paste. Choose the full check on this device or quick checks only. The optional EU route is marked unavailable. Nothing runs until you say so.
screenshots.caption: Choose the exact text, then choose where it is read. Nothing runs until you decide.

screenshots.alt: A clear reading, with patterns you can inspect. A five-band dial and a level in plain words, followed by measured writing observations with examples from your text. The model score is a pattern reading, never a percentage of AI-written words.
screenshots.caption: A five-band reading followed by measured writing observations and examples from the draft.

screenshots.alt: Open a section, and its evidence opens in place. A section score opens into the passage the model read, what we can measure in it against typical human and AI values, and any editing advice. One section at a time, with a strip that names it and steps to the next.
screenshots.caption: A section row opens in place: the passage, the measured signals and any editing advice.

screenshots.alt: Every check named, and what the result does not mean. Three separate readings, every method with its status, version and limits, and a plain statement that no result proves who wrote a text.
screenshots.caption: Every named check, its status and limits, and what the result does not mean.
